potential: ACE PdH_PBE_v03a (atomic cluster expansion fitted to VASP PBE data; Qamar, Ngoipala, Mrovec, Drautz et al. 2026, Zenodo 20591788). Evaluated exactly by the lab.
energy_zero: Isolated atoms have zero energy (the potential is fitted to DFT energies minus free-atom reference energies). DFT records below use the same zero.

structure_format.notes: Cartesian Angstrom, periodic in all directions, at most 300 atoms (DFT records below list fractional positions: Cartesian = fractional @ cell)

energy.returns: energy, forces, stress, pressure and volume of up to 8 structures

relax.returns: relaxed structure and its properties; volume = isotropic cell scaling to zero pressure, cell = full cell relaxation to zero stress, fixed = atom indices held in place

scan.returns: total energy with atom `index` moved to each point, every other atom frozen. Either an explicit list of points within a 4 A box, or a cubic grid center + (i, j, k) * spacing with |i|, |j|, |k| <= floor(half_width / spacing), returned in C order (x slowest). At most 10000 points; requests are limited to 64 kB, so use the grid form for large scans

dft_reference.returns: archived DFT (VASP PBE) energy, forces and stress of up to 4 records listed below

H2.note: mu(300 K, 1 bar) - E_static(molecule) per molecule, and zero-point energy, from experimental spectroscopic data (ideal gas, rotor with nuclear-spin statistics)

D2.note: mu(300 K, 1 bar) - E_static(molecule) per molecule, and zero-point energy, from experimental spectroscopic data (ideal gas, rotor with nuclear-spin statistics)
